name: silvershop/barcodes
description: Barcode image generation for SilverShop (CMS 6): render EAN-13, Code128 and QR codes to inline SVG or a PNG data-URI, from any code string or — guarded — from a product's GTIN stored by silvershop/product-identity. For packing slips, invoices, shipping labels, PDFs and POS/scanning. Generation only; the codes live in product-identity.

suggest.silvershop/product-identity: Auto-exposes a product's GTIN as a barcode on Product and Variation (the $BarcodeSVG / $Code128SVG / $QrCodeSVG template accessors); without it, barcodes still renders any code string you hand the BarcodeGenerator service.
suggest.silvershop/core: Required by silvershop/product-identity; needed for the Product/Variation template accessors (the generator service itself is standalone).
suggest.ext-gd: Enables PNG output (picqer PNG + endroid PngWriter); SVG output needs no extension.
